responsibility: Declaration header for GNAT’s portable environment-management API. It publishes the small set of __gnat_* routines for getenv/setenv/environ/unsetenv/clearenv that Ada runtime code imports, separating the stable C interface from the host-specific implementations in env.c.
same_name_distinction: This is the API header in the env pair: it only declares the small __gnat_* environment-management entry points for callers. Unlike gcc/ada/env.c, it contains no platform-specific environment access or mutation code and exists solely as the interface published to the rest of GNAT.
